# Remaining Work — Shliach Homepage Campaign

The Awtsmoos renews each pixel before the browser can know,
Awtsmoos.com will make the Shliach doorway unmistakably glow.

## Observed reality
- Home already boots `installShliachSpotlight(document)` from the real ESM flow.
- `ShliachSpotlightContent.js` points first to a local cached logo; the requested public Drive image is not wired there.
- The existing contract preserves the exact GPT id, authenticated-API copy, safe external-link law, and cached fallback asset.
- `/Shliach` and `/shliach` do not exist, so the route family is new work rather than an overwrite.

## REMAINING_WORK
1. Complete three architecture passes and a final file map before source code grows.
2. Rewrite the Home Shliach content module so the canonical public logo appears, with local cache fallback in tow.
3. Create `/Shliach/` as the SEO-rich landing page with images, descriptions, poems, prompt portal, and direct GPT link.
4. Create `/Shliach/prompts/`, `/Shliach/poems/`, and `/Shliach/gallery/` so distinct discovery intents can flow.
5. Create shared CSS modules: small, readable, animated, responsive, accessible, and never cramped.
6. Create shared browser JS for encoded prompt launching and optional reveal motion with progressive enhancement.
7. Preserve reduced-motion support, keyboard focus, semantic headings, descriptive alt text, and safe new-tab behavior.
8. Add tests only after the source implementation is complete, according to repository law.
9. Re-read every touched file fully and record planned-versus-actual delta.
10. Run static contracts, JS syntax checks, line-count checks, and browser/HTTP verification before completion may glow.

## NEXT_ACTION
Complete all three planning passes, then execute full-file source writes in one controlled implementation pass; no partial patch may flow.
